name: CINDER v1.1.2 results reference-model policy
rationale: The general v1.1.2 results programme is intended to stress belt, closure, hybrid-contact and actuator dynamics over a wide operating domain. A bilateral/slotted torque-reactive helix is a valid CVT design and prevents selected-flank lift-off from obscuring those questions. Unilateral-versus-slotted behavior should be isolated in its own dedicated topology study.

activation.stock_unilateral_opt_in: Use cinder.contracts.decode_simulation_case_document directly in a study that explicitly wants the published unilateral topology.

provenance_note: The frozen public JSON still encodes the published unilateral helix element. Studies using the shared results decoder apply the declared bilateral/slotted topology after public decoding and should record that choice beside generated artifacts.
